invariants.rationale: HoodieJavaTable.create should return a HoodieTable instance, so result is expected to be non-null at method exit.
The new HoodieTable created via HoodieJavaTable.create is expected to use the same config passed in.
The result table likely references the context passed as a constructor argument.
As the result is created via HoodieJavaTable.create, it should always be an instance of HoodieJavaTable.
